alignments.note: Ordinary conditional particle aligned to if; no negative is fused with it, so rule 39 is not in question.

The indefinite is the object of both coordinated verbs and the ASV realizes it twice, at all and aught; rule 15 permits the discontinuous unit and rule 103's contrast keeps a resumptive indefinite pronoun with the word it belongs to rather than marking it added. Marking aught added under rule 103 remains defensible.
Inflected verb with subject and auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb.
The pronoun's English is written twice, once in each coordinated clause; rule 7 keeps the asterisked repetition with the word that licenses it, discontinuously under rule 15.
Substantival demonstrative; no article stands with it.
Dative pronoun with its case preposition, headed on the possessive that realizes the pronoun.
The verb of reckoning is rendered by the light frame put ... to account; rule 17 heads on the meaning-bearing complement account rather than on put. Discontinuous under rule 15.

review_notes: The two asterisked words are treated as second realizations of tokens already present rather than as added: thee repeats se and aught repeats ti, both pronominal and so within rule 7's list.
The ti unit's note names the competing reading that marks aught added under rule 103.
